interpretation.denominators: Per-system rates use observed deduplicated attempts. WER uses reference words of scored items. No inference is made about jobs absent from raw.jsonl.
interpretation.completeness: eos_audio_success_rate is audio available plus EOS / attempted items. It is operational completion, not proof all words were spoken. Normalized exact match is ASR transcript agreement.
interpretation.sensitivity: Every unscored attempted item (failure, pending, invalid score) is assigned an empty hypothesis: all reference words deleted. This penalizes missing output but is NOT a mathematical upper bound; WER can exceed 100% through insertions.
interpretation.pairing: Common-success analysis and deletion sensitivity use only shared attempted id/seed pairs. Missing jobs are counted, never invented as completed or failed.
interpretation.uncertainty: Length-stratified text-cluster bootstrap retains all observed paired seeds per text, recomputes micro WER, and reports method minus baseline; negative delta favors method.
interpretation.time: Generation/ASR durations are summed from last records. Audio duration includes inserted segmentation pauses; failed attempts may lack duration. These totals are not full wall-clock run duration.
